verdict.rationale: Terraform is an official, documented CLI (probe-5). It has strong agent-friendly traits: `-json` machine-readable streaming output for plan/apply/test, `show -json`, `-auto-approve` for non-interactive runs, saved plan files, and Unix-tool-friendly state commands. Community users confirm hands-on CLI use such as `terraform state mv` and import. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of the CLI being driven by AI agents specifically.
